text: OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE defaults to 512. The pending channel is buffered to that size; when full a request fails immediately with ErrMaxQueue ('server busy, please try again. maximum pending requests exceeded'), surfaced as HTTP 503. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: When a new model does not fit, the scheduler picks the runner with shortest session duration (refCount 0 first), forces its sessionDuration to 0, unloads it and retries; queued requests are processed in order. If load OOMs with others resident, all other runners are evicted once before retry. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: A loaded runner is reloaded (not reused) if options, context shift, adapters, projector differ or the health ping fails, so varying num_ctx or other options per request between callers triggers reloads and cold starts. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: Ollama exposes no queue-depth metric; ollama ps and /api/ps list loaded models only, so queueing must be inferred client-side from time-to-first-byte or counted 503s. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-11)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL defaults to 1 in envconfig; required memory scales with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL * OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH (a 2K context with 4 parallel requests becomes 8K). (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS: env default is 0, which the scheduler turns into 3 * max(GPU count,1); a model loads concurrently only if it fits in memory, and on GPU must fit fully in VRAM. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: Requests for an already-loaded model reuse the runner and skip the pending queue, so the 503 applies to requests needing a model load, not those waiting on a parallel slot. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: Default keep-alive is 5 minutes. Per-request keep_alive on /api/generate and /api/chat overrides OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE; 0 unloads right after the response, negative (e.g. -1) keeps loaded forever. Env parsing accepts durations or integer seconds; an unparseable value silently keeps 5m. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction

text: The scheduler forces numParallel to 1 for embedding models and for some architectures (e.g. mllama, qwen35, lfm2), regardless of OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama server scheduling: NUM_PARALLEL / MAX_LOADED_MODELS / MAX_QUEUE / keep_alive eviction
